title: CLEANUP: false comment claiming TEST_HASH is SHA-256 of a specific string
description: test/wp11_test_keystore.c line ~376 comment: '/* P-256 SHA-256 hash of "wolfP11 test vector 1" */'. The bytes in TEST_HASH are not the SHA-256 of that string. The hash value is irrelevant to the test (it only needs to be 32 bytes to be a plausible ECDSA input) but the false comment violates test hygiene. A reviewer may waste time verifying the claim. Fix: replace the comment with '/* Fixed 32-byte test digest — value is arbitrary; test is independent of the preimage. */' Match the phrasing used in wp11_test_pkcs11.c line ~1078 which correctly describes its constant.
